title: Midnight Dates and Medjool Date Chutney
description: A sweet and spicy Indian-inspired chutney made with midnight and medjool dates. Perfect as a side or accompaniment to naan or tandoori chicken.
instructions: 1. In a pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
2. Add the grated ginger and sauté for 1 minute.
3. Add the minced garlic and chopped green chilies. Sauté for another minute.
4. Add the pitted midnight and medjool dates. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5. Add the chopped cilantro, lemon juice, and salt. Mix well.
6. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes or until the chutney thickens.
7. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
8. Store the chutney in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
